import datetime,json,re,subprocess
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
p=subprocess.run(['/cm/shared/apps/pbspro/current/bin/qstat','-fx','710213.hopper-m-02'],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=30)
print(p.stdout,end='');print(p.stderr,end='')
p.check_returncode()
fields={}
for key in ('job_state','qtime','stime','run_count','exec_host','queue','resources_used.walltime'):
 m=re.search(r'^\s*'+re.escape(key)+r' = (.*)$',p.stdout,re.M)
 fields[key]=m.group(1) if m else None
if fields['qtime']:
 t=datetime.datetime.strptime(fields['qtime'],'%a %b %d %H:%M:%S %Y').replace(tzinfo=ZoneInfo('Asia/Singapore'))
 fields['qtime_utc']=t.astimezone(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()
 fields['q20_deadline_utc']=(t+datetime.timedelta(seconds=1200)).astimezone(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()
fields['scope']='Read-only second authorized query; no cancellation'
print('QUEUE_TIMING_JSON: '+json.dumps(fields,sort_keys=True),flush=True)
